search_query: cat:cs.RO OR cat:eess.SY OR ((cat:cs.AI OR cat:cs.CV OR cat:cs.LG) AND (all:robot OR all:embodied OR all:manipulation OR all:autonomous))

topic_rules.label: 世界模型 / WAM
topic_rules.pattern: world[- ]action model|robot(?:ic)? world model|video world model|world model.{0,32}robot|memory[- ]prediction[- ]action model|steerable action model

topic_rules.label: 规划与控制
topic_rules.pattern: motion planning|task and motion|trajectory optimization|model predictive control|\bMPC\b|robot control|control policy

topic_rules.label: 仿真 / 数据 / 评测
硬件与传感
